title: Beyond Sentiment: The Value and Measurement of Consumer Certainty in Language
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences design. Construction and validation of a text-based Certainty Lexicon; predictive regressions with Twitter, reviews and commercial outcomes.
design_notes: Lexicon validation across social media datasets, lab experiments and online reviews; Super Bowl commercial tweets analysis is a prediction exercise, not a staggered adoption design.
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Lexicon is public (CertaintyLexicon.com) but no DiD.
